payload.instance: uuid — the battlemap instance the token stands on, when the command names no target; never written
payload.token: uuid — the token whose badge is set, a token of that instance (instance-isolated); never written, the change lands on the token's own row
payload.state: string — the condition, « Empoisonné », « À terre »…, kept without the blanks around it; empty or blank is refused
payload.on: boolean — true puts the badge on the token, after the others and once; false takes it off, the others keep their order
